    Lemma 2.4: modules over a quotient algebra #

    Let I be a two-sided ideal of A and B = A ⧸ I. For modules on which A acts through B (IsScalarTower A B M), A-linear and B-linear maps coincide, so bricks, submodules and the smaller-brick conclusion agree over A and B (isBrick_quot_iff, HasSmallerBrick.of_quot). Brick-finiteness and representation-finiteness pass from A to B (IsBrickFinite.quot, IsRepFinite.quot).

    An A-module killed by I becomes a B-module through Module.IsTorsionBySet.module, with the required scalar tower.
